blocks.html: Mechanical ventilation in dry cleaning plants shall be provided and shall be adequate to protect employees and the public in accordance with this section and DOL 29 CFR Part 1910.1000, where applicable. Dry cleaning separations must comply with the requirements of Section 415.9.3 of the New York City Building Code and NFPA 32.
